translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: S'ammak'iyaa Yohaannisi Yesuusaw Ogiyaa Giigissee

S'ibaariyoosa geetettiyaa kaatii kawuteedda tammanne ichcheshetsiyaa laytsaan P'ens's'enaawiyaa P'ilaas'oosi Yihudaa mooddiyaa wode, Heroodise Galiilaan oyddentsiyaa shaakuwaa mooddiyaa wode, Aa ishay Pilip'p'oosikka Is'uuriyaaninne S'irkkonddoosan oyddentsiyaa shaakuwaa mooddiyaa wode, Lisaaniyoosikka Abileenen oyddentsiyaa shaakuwaa mooddiyaawaa gidiide mooddi de'ishshin,
Haanninne K'eyyaafay k'eesatuwaa kaappatuwaa
gidiide de'ishshin, S'oossaa k'aalay Zakkaraasa na'aa Yohaannisakko mela biittaan yeedda.
Yohaannisi Yorddaanoosa Shaafaa heeraa ubbaa biide, «Hintte nagaray atto geetettana mala nagaraa paas'iide s'ammak'ettite» yaagi tamaarisseedda.
yaageedda.
Hawaa diraw Yohaannisi Aa kushiyan s'ammak'ettanaw keseedda asaw hawaadan oduwaa doommeedda, «Henttenoo, shooshshaa naatoo; yiyaa hank'k'uwaappe attana mala hinttentta ooni mak'k'eeddee?
Simmi hinttenttu nagaraappe simmeeddawanttoo bessiyaa ayfiyaa ayfite. Hinttenttu wozanaan Abraahaamo nu aabbu de'ee gooppite. S'oossay Abraahaamoo
naanaa ha shuchchatuwaappe dentsanaw danddayee yaagaade taani hinttenttoo oday.
Ha"i ubbaa bees'i mitsaa s'ap'uwaan k'ans's'anaw giigi utteedda; simmi lo"o ayfiyaa ayfena mitsay ubbay k'ans's'ettiide tamaan olettanawaa.»
«Yaatina ha"i nu ayaa udanee?» yaagiide Aa c'ora Asay oochcheedda.
Yohaannisikka, «Laa"u mayuu de'iyaawe baynnawoo immo; k'umay de'iyaawekka baynnawoo gisho» yaagi zaareedda.
K'aras'aa shiishshiyaawanttukka s'ammak'ettanaw yiide, «Tamaarissiyaawoo, nu ayaa udanee?» yaagi oochcheeddino.
I unttunttoo, «Geetettowaappe aad'd'o k'aras'aa aatsi shiishshoppite» yaagi odeedda.

Hewaappe kaala wotaadaratuu, «Nuunishi, ayaa udanee?» yaagi Aa oochcheeddino. Yohaannisikka, «Asaa shaluwaa naak'uwaan bonk'k'i akkoppite, oonanne wordduwaan mootoppite, hinttenttu dirgguu hinttenttoo gidana» yaagi zaareedda.
He wode Asay ubbay Kiristtoosa yuussaa naagiidde de'iyaa diraw Yohaannisa, «Hawekka Kiristtoosa gidennaan attena» yaagiide barenttu wozanaan maleeddino.
Yohaannisi ubbatuwaakka, «Taani haatsaan s'ammak'ay; gidoppe attin taappe wolk'k'aamaynne taanikka Aa c'aammaa k'ashuwaa billana danddayennawe
biro yaanawaa; ikka Ayaanaa Geeshshaaninne tamaan s'ammak'anawaa;
Aa kushiyan katsaa dalaappe shaakki geeshshiyaa layday de'ee. Katsaa uddumaan bukkowaa geeshshi punniide ayfiyaa diyiyaan k'olee; shin dalaa to'enna tamaan guuddee.»
Yohaannisikka hara c'ora k'aalaan c'ora asaa mak'k'iidde mishiraachchuwaa k'aalaa odeedda.
Heroodise S'ammak'iyaa Yohaannisa K'achcheedda
Galiilaa mooddiyaa Heroodisa k'ay bare ishaa Pilip'p'oosa machchatto Herodiyaado I akkeedda dirawunne haraakka c'ora iita kiitaa kiitetto diraw, Yohaannisi seereedda.
Hawaa diraw ha ubbaa gujjiide Heroodise Yohaannisa k'asho golle gelisseedda.
Yohaannisi Yesuusa S'ammak'eedda
Asay ubbay s'ammak'etti simmowaappe guyyiyaan Yesuusi s'ammak'etteedda. I woossi de'ishshinkka saluu dooyetti aggeedda.
Geeshsha Ayyaanaykka harap'p'iyaa malatiide Aa bollaan wod'd'eedda. Saluwaappekka, «Ta dosiyaa na'ay neena; neenan Taani nashettay» yaagiyaa k'aalay yeedda.
Yesuusa Yeletay Kase GuyyeMayzzaappe De'iyaa Payduwaa
Yesuusi tamaarissuwaa doommoode aw hattamu laytsaa gideedda; c'ora asaykka barenttoo malatowaadan Aa Yooseefo na'aa yaagiino; Yooseefo Eele na'aa;
Eele Maate na'aa; Maate Leewiyaa na'aa; Leewii Milkke na'aa; Milkke Yoona na'aa; Yooni Yooseefo na'aa;

Eere Yoosee'e na'aa; Yoosee'e, Eli'eezera na'aa; Eli'eezere, Yooraame na'aa; Yooraami Maas'aate na'aa; Maas'aate Leewiyaa na'aa;
Leewii Simoona na'aa; Simoone Yihudaa na'aa; Yihuday Yooseefo na'aa; Yooseefo Yoonaana na'aa; Yoonaani Eeliyaak'eema na'aa;
Eeliyaak'eemi Meeliya na'aa; Meeliye Mayinaana na'aa; Mayinaani Maas'aate na'aa; Maas'aate Naataane na'aa; Naataane Daawite na'aa;
Daawite Issey na'aa; Issey Iyyoobeedda na'aa; Iyoobeedi Boo'eeza Na'aa; Boo'eezi Salmoona na'aa; Salmooni Nahishoona na'aa;
Nahishooni Aminaadaaba na'aa; Aminaadaabi Raama na'aa; Raami Ariina na'aa; Ariinay Hezroona na'aa; Hezrooni Pereeza na'aa; Pereezi Yihudaa na'aa;
Yihuday Yaak'ooba na'aa; Yaak'oobi Yisaak'a na'aa; Yisaak'i Abraahaamo na'aa; Abraahaamo Taara na'aa; Taari Naakoora na'aa;
Naakoori Seeroohe na'aa; Seeroohi Ragawa na'aa; Ragawi Pelega na'aa; Pelegi Abeera na'aa; Abeeri Saalla na'aa;

footnotes.text: K'eesatuwaa kaappatuu Haanninne K'eyyaafay: Haanna kaappotetsaa wodii Yesuusi yelettanaappe kase 6-15 laytsaa gakkanaassa. K'eyyaafaa geetettiyaa Haanna bolluu 18-37 laytsaa kaappo gidiide Yesuusa yeletaappe kase gam"eedda.
Abraahaamoo naanaa: Ayihuda asatuu barentta S'oossay dooreedda asaa yaagi k'oppiino. Gaasuunnekka, beni hidootaa k'aalay S'oossaappe nu aabbu Abraahaamoo imetteedda yaagiide k'oppiyaa diraassa.
Aa c'aammaa k'ashuwaa billana danddayennawe: Hawe k'oomaa woy danggaas'iratti oosuwaa.
